Anya K.: quick heads-up — I'm planning a bulk remap of legacy contact tags (partner_onboarded, early_engaged, pilot) into the new enablement_cohort taxonomy. Dry-run Tue 9am PT, target full run Wed night. Expect healthscore fluctuations for ~2% of accounts.
Samir: sounds good. what's the rollback plan if scores spike?
Anya K.: rollback = restore old cohort tags + recalculation using snapshot from before run; script saves snapshot to s3://cs-snapshots/enablement-remap/{ts}. Will also toggle playbook automation during dry-run.
Jordan L.: can you paste the mapping rules? want to check our welcome nudge playbook mapping.
Anya K.: mapping below. it's conservative — only remap when tag confidence >= 0.7.
Anya K.: ```sql
-- remap example
UPDATE contacts SET enablement_cohort = 'pilot' WHERE tag = 'pilot' AND tag_confidence >= 0.7;
UPDATE contacts SET enablement_cohort = 'early_adopter' WHERE tag IN ('early_engaged','beta_user') AND last_activity_days < 30;
```
Lina M.: FYI the welcome nudge playbook fires off enablement_cohort == 'early_adopter' + onboarding_step < 3. will we pause that during dry-run?
Anya K.: yes pausing playbook triggers for cohort changes during dry-run. ops-bot will set `playbook:paused=enablement-cohort-remap` and send a reminder.
ops-bot: playbook automation pause set by Anya K. — reason: enablement cohort remap dry-run; expires in 24h :white_check_mark:
Samir: can you add a sampling check? sample 500 accounts and run scoring pipeline to compare before/after.
Anya K.: already on it. sample id: remap-sample-20260324. I'll post delta table results in #cs-analytics after dry-run.
Jordan L.: tagging owners: @Lina M., @Samir for playbook sanity, @Anya K. to run. If anything weird, tag `@oncall-cs` and we'll roll back.
Anya K.: thanks — I'll post the S3 snapshot and delta CSV once done. ping me if you want early access to the dry-run logs.
